content:
ali: Heads-up — I'm proposing we convert a subset of our GPU fleet alerts from paging to ticketing to cut noise during autoscaler churn. Draft below.
maria: Which alerts are you thinking about? the OOMs? node-heartbeat flaps?
ali: Mainly: node_memory_available < 2Gi for single nodes, pod_eviction_count spikes tied to spot reclaim, and transient k8s pod restarts that self-heal within 5m. These are ~60% of pages overnight.
ryan: Agree re: noise. Ops SLA still needs pages for real degradation though. Suggest we add hysteresis and grouping first, not straight demotion.
zoe: Could we do: page on sustained cluster-wide capacity loss (percent nodes unhealthy > 10% for 15m), ticket on single-node transient issues (3 occurrences in 10m)?
ali: Yes exactly. Proposed rules:
- severity=page: cluster_unhealthy_nodes_ratio > 0.1 for 15m OR model-serving_latency_p95 > 3s for 10m
- severity=ticket: node_memory_available < 2Gi but only after 3 fires within 12m (sliding window), or pod_restart_count > 5 for 30m
- add mute window during scheduled scale events: label autoscaler_window=true to silence tickets (but pages still send)
maria: How would we implement the "3 fires in 12m" in Prometheus/Grafana? Recording rule + alert expr?
ali: Quick example recording/alert combo:
```
# recording rule
- record: node_low_mem_events:count5m
  expr: increase(node_memory_low{job="node-exporter"}[5m])

# alert
- alert: NodeLowMemoryRepeated
  expr: increase(node_low_mem_events:count5m[12m]) >= 3
  labels:
    severity: ticket
  annotations:
    runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/node-low-memory
```
ryan: For Alertmanager routing, we should add a page receiver routing tree and a ticket receiver that creates Jira issues via webhook. Also add group_by: [cluster, region] to reduce duplicate pages.
zoe: Don't forget to include throttling for spot reclaim floods — group_interval: 10m and repeat_interval: 2h for ticket receiver.
ali: Good point. Also add a Grafana alert rule for model-serving_latency with for: 10m to avoid single noisy spike paging.
sre-bot: automated-note: recorded change proposal created in /ops/alert-proposals/1758123456-pager-hysteresis-proposal.md
maria: I like this. One ask: add an explicit test plan — create synthetic low-memory events in staging and verify only tickets are generated for single-node issues.
ryan: I'll own the test harness. Plan: inject 2Gi allocatable drop, run chaos monkey to evict 10 nodes, verify page fires when >10% of nodes affected, otherwise tickets.
zoe: +1 :thumbsup: If this lands, can we also add a dashboard panel that shows alert state by severity over time (pages vs tickets) so we can measure noise reduction?
ali: Yup, put a panel in Fleet -> Alerts with a flux of alert_states{severity} and a 7d moving average.
maria: timeline? Can we aim to ship the Alertmanager routing + recording rules by EOD Thursday, test Friday, and rollout Mon next week? 
ali: Sounds good. I'll PR the prometheus rules and a skeleton Alertmanager config today.
ryan: Ping @oncall when you merge so they can ack new routes.
ali: Will do. Thanks team.
